proposals.before: After the Kaiyao era, a Guizhou intra-circuit frontier commissioner was appointed, commanding fourteen prefectures—Gui, Wu, He, Lian, Liu, Fu, Zhao, Meng, Yan, Huanrong, Gu, Sitang, and Gong—from his seat at Guizhou.
proposals.after: After the Kaiyao era, a Guizhou intra-circuit frontier commissioner was appointed, commanding fourteen prefectures—Gui, Wu, He, Lian, Liu, Fu, Zhao, Meng, Yan, Huan, Rong, Gu, Sitang, and Gong—from his seat at Guizhou.
proposals.reason: Chinese lists fourteen prefectures; 環融 must be two (環 and 融). English fused them as Huanrong, leaving only thirteen names.

proposals.before: After Kaiyao, a Guizhou intra-circuit frontier commissioner was established, holding Gui, Wu, He, Lian, Liu, Fu, Zhao, Meng, Yan, Huanrong, Gu, Sitang, and Gong prefectures—fourteen in all—with seat at Guizhou.
proposals.after: After Kaiyao, a Guizhou intra-circuit frontier commissioner was established, holding Gui, Wu, He, Lian, Liu, Fu, Zhao, Meng, Yan, Huan, Rong, Gu, Sitang, and Gong prefectures—fourteen in all—with seat at Guizhou.
proposals.reason: Chinese lists fourteen prefectures; 環融 must be two (環 and 融). Literal English fused them as Huanrong, leaving only thirteen names.

decisions.reason: Chinese 領…十四州 enumerates fourteen prefectures; with 環融 kept as one name the list has only thirteen. Splitting 環融 into 環 and 融 yields fourteen single-name prefectures matching the stated total; English Huanrong must become Huan, Rong.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 領桂、梧、賀、連、柳、富、昭、蒙、嚴、環融、古、思唐、龔十四州

decisions.reason: Same unit: 十四州 requires fourteen names; 環融 is two prefectures (環、融) omitted as a separator in the Chinese list. Literal Huanrong is the fused error; Huan, Rong restores the count and naming.
